title: 0xRig
tagline: A free virtual crypto phone. Download 0xrig and spin a new Crypto Phone to talk with your Peers on LENS.
description: 0xrig allows anyone to create a Free Crypto Phone using LENS, LivePeer and LIT. Start communicating with the world without knowing any code. Talk to your contacts without sharing your name, email or any other personal information. Compatible with burner wallets. Search for LENS accounts and call anyone that follows you.
how_its_made: 0xrig is an open-source platform built on top of LENS API, LivePeer API and LIT JS-SDK. Users authenticate with Metamask and start interacting with the LENS API. You can call anyone that follows you and start streaming right from your browser. Download 0xrig by a new GitPod container or install it on your raspberry pi or personal computer. Call anyone that follows you on LENS.
